working_case: cases/team_handoff/case.json has the same dimensions; case_config.vh permits bounded shape regressions.

stage_mapping.detail: Preloads activation and all nine kernel matrices into input SRAM. Published starter writes activations once and weights in each kij iteration.
Published L0 write and PE load placeholders are implemented through xmem_to_l0 and L0 west-to-east loading.
Implements OFIFO-to-psum-SRAM placeholder; checks valid and extra outputs.
Computes equivalent gather addresses from geometry, accumulates nine contributions, writes back and reads SRAM.
Explicit ReLU command, independent result SRAM writeback and readback.

additional_verification: stage 50 reads raw kernel psums and is accounted separately from required stages; repeated jobs and final SRAM result export are also checks.

published_holes.detail: Literal ... placeholders make the published file intentionally incomplete.
acc_file is declared and used, but no $fopen(acc_file) or equivalent address generation is provided.
out.txt naming/header handling and direct sfp_out comparison need adaptation to actual handoff vectors.

working_interface_extensions: sfp_clear: clear an individual output sum without clearing SRAM
sfp_relu: explicit ReLU separate from accumulation/hold
pmem_from_sfp: select SFU output for true SRAM writeback
timing_difference: Published starter toggles a 1ns clock manually and registers controls at posedge. Working TB drives controls on negedge, checks after rising edges, and uses a 10ns simulation clock; cycle counts are meaningful, simulated period is not FPGA Fmax.
scope: Compatibility audit and source archive only. The published template was not compiled because it contains deliberate placeholders. The actual working TB passed the fresh Vivado team_handoff repeat=2 run.
